notes.title: Wildlife Park 3 Asia - A True Animal Resort
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/958381/Wildlife_Park_3__Asia/

Asia is the largest continent on earth. With an area of ​​approximately 44.614 million square kilometers (31.7 million square kilometers without Russia) it covers about one third of the total landmass. Here are all climate zones represented. The tropical rainforest of Southeast Asia is probably the richest ecosystem on earth.

The wildlife of Asia, which is also the content of this DLC, includes in the treeless tundra of the Arctic Circle [b]Pacific Walruses [/b] and in the boreal zone of taiga forests, with their significant fauna for historical hunting, [b]Axis Deers[/b] and [b]Eurasian Lynxs[/b].

The subtropical grasslands and steppes are home to [b]Saiga Antelopes[/b], [b]Bactrian Camels[/b], [b]Indian Rhinoceroses[/b], [b]Indian Blackbucks[/b] and [b]Przewalski Horses[/b].

In the low-vegetation, rocky mountainous landscapes along the Himalayas lives the [b]Takins[/b] and the [b]Red Pandas[/b]. These are best adapted to the harsh highland climate with its extreme temperature fluctuations.

The greatest biodiversity can be found in the tropical rainforests of India, Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands. [b]Indian Elephants[/b], [b] Fishing cats[/b], [b]Malayan Tapirs[/b], [b]Orangutans [/b] and the [b]Komodo Dragon[/b], a species that looks most like a dragon.

notes.title: An adventure trip to Down Under!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/798320/Wildlife_Park_3__Down_Under/

Visit australia - the home of koalas and kangaroos. From the Great Barrier Reef to the outback, the Aboriginal homeland of Australia.
The continent offers a wide range of fauna and flora: Kangaroos, koalas, emus-and of course - the tousled wombat and the strange platypus, the  "landmarks " from Down Under. 

Keep sea creatures like sharks, dwarf saw rays, dolphins and wall reef turtles as well as reptiles like the perentie and the freshwater crocodiles. In the australian wildlife you will also find birds like cormorants and eyeglasses pelicans as well as the colourful helmet cassowary, a primevally maddish bird. Wildlife Park's flora is expanded with 'Down under' around Australia's typical eucalyptus trees.

For visitors to your Australian wildlife Park, you'll have a variety of new service facilities from Shark Trashcan to Infodoos, a Sydney Opera Restaurant, Outback Toilets to tourist attractions such as Submarine Diving on the Great Barrier Reef and Helicopter Tours available. Lastly, you decorate your 'Down Under' Park with many typical decorations such as didgeridoos, surfboards and the famous Ayers Rock. 

"Down Under"-Features:
+ 20 Australian land and aquatic species, such as Kangurus, Koalas, Emus, Wombats, crocodiles, dolphins and of course sharks
+ 3 Theme park attractions, including submarine diving at the Great Barrier Reef
+ 10  visitor facilities such as the Sydney Opera restaurant and outback toilets
+ 7 decorations with different variations such as Ayersrock, Digeridoos, Boomerang and surfboard signs
+ 2 Eucalyptus tree species

notes.title: Creatures of the Caribbean set free!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/767580/Wildlife_Park_3__Creatures_of_the_Caribbean/

Create magnificent palm beaches with lagoons and bays. Animate these with dolphins, dangerous sharks, giant turtles, colourful flamingos and many other animal inhabitants of the Caribbean Sea.
Let your park visitors immerse themselves in the world of pirates. Hurl them in the arms of a giant octopus or on Sir Francis Drake's steering wheel through the skies before entertain at the stalls with dried meat and cocktails.

Caribbean Features:
- 20 Caribbean species, such as dolphins, sharks, flamingos, crocodiles and turtles
- 4 theme park attractions such as The Pirate Swing and the Flying Crow's Nest
- 10 visitor facilities such as the Elixierspender and the dried meat hut
- 14 decorations with different variations like the brain coral and the Pirate Shield
- 4 new aquatic and submerged plants

Alaska stretches from the Pacific to the Arctic Ocean and the Bering Sea to Canada over an area of 1.717.854 km². The vegetation zones ranging from coastal rain forests of to Arctic tundra. Large parts of Alaska are designated as protected areas. In addition to the eight national parks, there are five national monuments, 16 national wildlife refuge and several other protected areas.
